Spec-compliance review of PR #17, story US-03-05, round 1, at sha 1bf08f0 (diff `origin/main...1bf08f020081ade82256129382b781b796ffdc35`). Nothing blocks: criteria #1 to #4 are met with evidence and #5 is external. There are nine non-blocking findings (N1–N9 below).

**What I checked myself (read-only)**
- **Unit tests:** I ran `cards.test.tsx`, `AC-03-05-2-illustrations-black-and-white.test.js` and `illustrations-registered.test.js` at this sha: 3 suites, 44 tests, all pass. `tsc --noEmit` is clean. The worktree was clean.
- **The five PNGs:** `file` reports each as 180x180, 1-bit greyscale, non-interlaced. I looked at all five: none has text, and each matches its question (hand = 5 fingers, spider = 8 legs, ant = 6 legs, clock = 3:00, tree rings).
- **Local run** `test-runs/2026-10-16_010358`, on commit 1bf08f0 and not dirty: TC-03-20, TC-03-21 and TC-03-22 are each SUCCESS in their JUnit reports; TC-03-21 and TC-03-22 find `hand.png` pixel for pixel at (70,221) 180x180 before the reveal, after it, in Polish and in English; AC-03-05-2 passes in `junit/unit.xml`.
- **CI on 1bf08f0:** the Gates job succeeded; the "Acceptance tests (Android 12 emulator)" job was still in progress when I looked.

Traceability: #1–#4 MET, #5 EXTERNAL (TC-03-23 manual-only); MOD-01-F08, MOD-01-F13, MOD-03-U03 delivered; out-of-scope fences respected; constitution: no violation.
